description: Reserved Matters Application relating to the layout, scale, appearance, access and landscaping for the development of Plot 42A comprising residential units (Use Class C3) within a building of ground plus 7 storeys with associated amenity space, provision for cycle storage, refuse storage and plant. The application also proposes areas of landscaped open space including play space; on street loading bay; car parking; and new highway infrastructure inclusive of carriageway, junction arrangements and footways on the tertiary road between Plots 42 and 41, part of Spine Road North/Arbour Street, and southern extension of Railway Street together which will complete the circulation loop of the Transport Interchange T1 item of Critical Infrastructure. The application is submitted pursuant to Condition 1.3(v), 2.1 and 17.1 within the Phase 5D sub-phase of planning permission F/04687/13 dated 23/07/2014 (as amended) for the comprehensive mixed-use redevelopment of the Brent Cross Cricklewood Regeneration Area. The application is accompanied by an Environmental Statement of Compliance.
